canonical_definition: POPE (Pointing Out False Entities) is a benchmark designed to evaluate object hallucination in vision-language models (VLMs) through adversarial question-answering tasks. It assesses the model's ability to resist hallucinating objects not present in images by testing on subsets including random, popular, and adversarial configurations. The benchmark focuses on robustness against false entity generation, with higher scores indicating fewer hallucinations.
